messages:
maria: @support I'm seeing a recurring support case (cust: 12345) — structured/json mode rejects payloads that have Windows paths + embedded newlines. Posting minimal repro and error.

maria: request payload:
```json
{"mode":"json","prompt":"Open file at C:\\Users\\alice\\notes\\todo.txt\n- buy milk"}
```

maria: response (400):
```
{
  "error":"Invalid structured output",
  "message":"Unterminated string starting at position 47",
  "request_id":"req_abc123"
}
```

devon: Do we have the raw wire body and Content-Type? SDK? any middleware that might normalize newlines?

maria: Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
maria: using ruby-sdk v1.4.2 (curl payload identical)

support-bot: Incident created INC-2026: structured-json-escape-paths

sanjay: I can repro locally. looks like our json-mode serializer tries to sanitize, but backslash escaping + literal newline is ending the string early. Error stack:
```
JSONDecodeError: Invalid control character at 32 in "/usr/local/lib/.../serializer.py:88"
```

devon: temporary workaround: double-escape backslashes or replace backslashes with forward slashes before sending. e.g.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"mode":"json","prompt":"Open file at C:\\\\Users\\\\alice\\\\notes\\\\todo.txt\n- buy milk"}'
```

maria: confirmed double-escape fixes parse for the customer. customer wants permanent fix — they're on hosted API (paid tier) and it's blocking ingestion pipeline.

sanjay: I'll push a patch to the sanitizer to escape control chars in JSON strings (convert literal CR/LF to \n and ensure backslashes are quoted). Landing PR in eng-runtime. Adding canary rollout for 24h.

devon: assigning to eng-runtime, tagging billing/sales for customer SLA note.

alex-sales: +1, cc'ing acct team — customer SLA impacted, please add credit hold if rollout takes >48h.

maria: thanks — will update customer with workaround and ETA.
